completionNote: Expanded lesson pages with learning objectives, key terms, explanations, study steps, subject-specific study guidance, detailed subtopic checklists, worked-example method, activity, review questions, and summaries. English and SAT remain topic/skill based without grade selectors. Other subjects remain grade based. Unit-title lists were cross-checked against available online Ethiopian textbook catalogues and Ministry/schoolnet sources where accessible, but some Grade 11/12 topic lists and all detailed subtopic/learning-outcome mappings still require direct comparison with the exact current student textbook before claiming complete curriculum verification.
